newsitem.title: USA: FOCUS - APIs broadly neutral, gasoline a bit bullish.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - APIs broadly neutral, gasoline a bit bullish.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute (API) status report for the week ended March 14 was seen as broadly neutral, though some analysts reckoned a decline in gasoline stocks would be bullish in the short term.

The API reported Tuesday that crude stocks last week were up just 76,000 barrels nationwide, though that masked a rise of nearly 3.7 million barrels on the critical Gulf Coast where there is a heavy concentration of refineries.
The Gulf Coast figure was offset by a 4.5 million-barrel decline on the West Coast, which is considered a separate market to the main Gulf/East Coast/Midwest area.
